The seven MIND and eleven Ayele source-marginal operands agree with the admitted input; individual SDs are treated as unconditional dispersion, counts are distinct from rounded percentages, and unknown weights/divisors remain descriptive approximations. Six composite-diabetes ORs and ten abstract-only records remain contextual. The finite quadratic and moment derivations precede RNG; declared inverse-CDF endpoint safeguards are numerical, with no clinical row trimming. The only execution loop is the fixed one-or-three reading observation model; no host I/O, optimizer, seed search, cohort redraw or filtering is present. All three exact contexts, canonical five columns, 5000-row counts and distinct source/target age supports are preserved. The pre-freeze descriptor correction retained identical generator, decision and checks bytes. This approval concerns implementation, provenance and semantic consistency only, not runtime success, strict source replay, scientific transport or target validity.
